notes: Same source expansion convention as before; not vendor ISA or timing.
Eight fixed relief band evaluations now baked into existing roughness R/B/A channels; its G roughness and lookup are reused unchanged.
Sun/normal transforms, reach, reveal ratios, light strength, course drop and cavity/top factors now execute in the vertex stage; those operations are excluded from fragment totals, not erased.
Two Palace guards depend on a per-primitive constant building tag; arithmetic helpers have no Low branches.
No per-window branch: painted windows also evaluate one hash, with zero albedo tone weight.
The baseline Palace tone from 333706f^ was 169 total patch source ALU; revised 152 is lower even with reveal/course shading retained.
The full unrelated Three PBR, shadow, normal-map and interior code is not counted.
